login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to use this Meshloom.
login.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
login.rememberHint: Unchecked, you are signed out when you close the browser, and after 12 hours without activity.
login.insecureContext: This page is not served over HTTPS: your password travels unencrypted on the network. Use it only on a network you trust.

relogin.title: Session ended
relogin.body: Your session has ended. Sign in again to carry on where you were.

setup.title: Create the administrator account
setup.description: This Meshloom has no account yet. The one you create here can manage everything.
setup.passwordPolicy: At least {{min_length}} characters, different from the user name. A few words in a row make a good password.
setup.codeHint: This Meshloom asks for the 8-digit code it printed in its log: it already holds data, or it was opened from outside the local network (from the local network, a new Meshloom needs no code). Find it here:
setup.codeWhereDocker: Docker: docker logs <container> and look for “installation code”.
setup.codeWhereAddon: Home Assistant add-on: the Log tab of the add-on.
setup.codeWhereCli: Any install, a new code: meshloom-admin setup-code on the host.

userMenu.ingressNote: Home Assistant signs you in: there is no Meshloom session to end.
userMenu.stillSignedInNote: This device is still signed in: the server signs it in without a login (login-free on the local network). An administrator can change that in Settings → Users & Access.
